text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus, I hear
some
excited voices.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Princess, that pose you did in the
paddock was so
cool! It was like you
were doing a special move!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Yes! You looked so confident and
beautiful! ♪
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Good eyes, you two! You always know
just where
to look.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
That was my "Noblest of the Nobles"
pose. It's a
pose that shows off how
noble I am!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
"Noblest of the Nobles" pose?! Holy
smokes! Even
the name is cool as hell!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
You got any other poses? I definitely
wanna see
more!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy to show you! I am a princess
of the
people, after all. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Which would you like to see? The
"Mightiest of
the Mighty" pose or the
"Prettiest of the
Princesses" pose?
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: I mean, of course you should do the...
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Mightiest of the Mighty!
Prettiest of the
Princesses!
text_block_list.name: Водка and Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet, back off! I'm trying to learn
how to
get stronger here!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! You back off first! I want to
learn the
ways of a princess!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, oh dear. What a pickle we're
in...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Oh! You over there! Perfect timing!
Would you
mind doing us the honor of
choosing a pose?
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
choice_data_list: Do the Prettiest of the Princesses pose.
Mightiest of the Mighty sounds good to me.

text_block_list.text:
Very well—then feast your eyes,
everyone! My
Prettiest of the Princesses
pose looks like... this!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Hooo ho ho ho!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
This is the pose Shining Princess strikes
whenever
she's faced with trouble!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Shining Princess is the hero of Princess
Fighter,
right? I loved that show when I
was a kid!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There are fewer things more
inspiring
than a plucky princess who
remembers to stay
graceful no matter
what comes her way. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Graceful no matter what... How inspiring.
I want
to be like that too—
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
EEK! There's a bug on the ground right
by my
feet!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Interrupting a conversation
between
maidens? You're quite the little
pest, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: And rude bugs deserve this... HYAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Каваками Принцесс feeds the bug a
knuckle
sandwich!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: WA-BAM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That should do it. Consider our bug
problem
addressed.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Now we're free to talk to our hearts'
content! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Okay, then feast your eyes on my
Mightiest of
the Mighty pose!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: HYAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
This is the pose Shining Princess strikes
whenever
she's whooped a mighty foe!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Shining Princess is the hero of Princess
Fighter,
right? I loved that show when I
was a kid!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There are fewer things more
inspiring
than a spirited princess who
stays brave no matter
what enemy she
faces. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Such a powerful blow! You're
so cool!
Can you throw another?!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it would be my pleasure. Aaand...
HAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
She throws out another mighty punch...
or so I
expect, but for some reason her
jab seems
distinctly weaker than before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey now! That's no good at all,
Kawakami!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Has praise made you complacent? That
punch
had no power behind it.
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text: Gasp! How could I make a fool of myself in public like this?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: I'm a princess! I'm supposed to be graceful in all things! Oh, the shame! The embarrassment!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Dash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uh? What was so embarrassing?
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Incredible... I think this might be one
area where
I'm totally outmatched.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Who knows?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет
